content:
Not wanting to be upstaged by the all-new Mac mini and Mac Studio, Apple today also unveiled an updated version of its polishing cloth. In an era of price hikes across the board, the new polishing cloth has actually gotten cheaper, priced at US$9 (down from US$19).

It is currently unclear what changes have been made to the new polishing cloth. Apple's description of the new version is exactly the same as before:

Apple launched its polishing cloth in October 2021, and it was almost immediately sold out. Although it has become an internet meme, it is indeed a high-quality polishing cloth suitable for taking care of your Apple products.

You can order this "new" polishing cloth for US$9 on the Apple website today. I'd say place your order as soon as possible — although I'm only half-joking, there's a real chance it could sell out quickly.

If you want to own a piece of Apple history, the original polishing cloth can still be purchased on Amazon for US$19.
